## MorphoClientType interface

Structural contract the `morpho` namespace satisfies — the object exposed under `client.morpho` once a viem client is extended with [morphoViemExtension()](./morpho-sdk.morphoviemextension.md)<!-- -->. Carries the viem client, the resolved options bag, and the four entity-factory methods the SDK exposes.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface MorphoClientType
```
